title: Kid-Friendly Board
seo_title: Kid-Friendly Charcuterie Board: Easy Family Shopping List
description: A kid-friendly charcuterie board for 8–10 families: cheddar sticks, string cheese, pepperoni, rolled turkey, grapes, strawberries, Goldfish, pretzels and dips.
hook: No scary flavors, lots of color: a family board of foods kids already know, cut into shapes they can grab.
why: Kids eat more of what they recognize, so this board leads with familiar foods: cheddar sticks, string cheese, pepperoni and rolled turkey. Predictable shapes help too. Sticks and cubes feel safer than odd-shaped wedges.

Fruit arranged in rainbow order makes it fun and gets kids trying more colors. Dips are the other trick: ranch, jam and nut or sunflower butter make apples and crackers more interesting. Halve grapes lengthwise for children under 5.

timeline.what: Take the cheese out; wash the fruit (let the kids help).
Slice the apples, peel the mandarins and halve the strawberries.
Place the cheese and fill the dip cups.
Arrange the fruit in rainbow order; add crackers and pretzels.

faq.q: What do you put on a kids' charcuterie board?
faq.a: Mild cheddar, string cheese, pepperoni, rolled turkey or ham, grapes, strawberries, apple slices, blueberries, mandarins, Goldfish, pretzels, butter crackers and dips like ranch or jam.

faq.q: How do you make grapes safe for small children?
faq.a: Cut them in half lengthwise, or in quarters for toddlers. Whole grapes are a choking hazard for children under 5.
Use sunflower seed butter instead of peanut butter and check cracker labels for nut warnings.
